profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | AI Platforms and Applied AI
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer, AI Platforms and Solutions
profile.summary:
Senior AI Platform Engineer specializing in enterprise data platforms, GenAI systems, and cloud infrastructure. Experienced in building scalable, secure, and production-ready AI and data platforms that enable analytics, machine learning, and enterprise AI adoption in highly regulated industries.
Skilled in AWS, Azure, Databricks, and modern AI engineering patterns including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Agentic AI workflows.  Proven track record designing and operating enterprise platforms that improve developer productivity, data accessibility, governance, and operational efficiency at scale.
Brings deep experience working with sensitive healthcare and enterprise data, with a strong focus on security, compliance, data governance, and responsible AI adoption in complex regulatory environments.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Platforms and Solutions
positions.description:
- Build scalable AI platforms and applied AI solutions for enterprise applications.
- Design production-ready AI/ML architectures, data pipelines, and model serving solutions.
- Implement MLOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and observability for AI workloads.
- Collaborate across engineering, data science, and product teams to deliver AI capabilities.
- Lead technical design, architecture, and engineering best practices for AI initiatives
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Claude Code and +5 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI and Data Platforms
positions.description:
Senior AI Platform Engineer responsible for building and operating enterprise-grade data and AI platforms at Health Care Service Corporation, the largest private health insurer in the United States with tens of millions of members.  

-Led development and administration of the enterprise Databricks platform, enabling secure, scalable analytics, ML, and GenAI workloads across the organization.

-Acted as a platform SME for AI infrastructure, governance, and best practices in a highly regulated environment.

-Pioneered Generative AI use cases and provided technical leadership to help teams understand, adopt, and scale GenAI solutions responsibly.

-Designed and built an internal RAG-based knowledge assistant end-to-end, including system architecture, retrieval pipelines, multi-agent workflows, and a production-ready chat UI and web application.

-Implemented LLM-driven PII/PHI detection and classification across 2,000+ tables, strengthening HIPAA compliance and significantly reducing data exposure risk.

-Built LLM-powered metadata enrichment pipelines, generating business context for tables and columns to improve data discoverability, governance, and catalog accuracy.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform Engineering
positions.description:
Senior software engineer focused on building data platforms; responsible for building and scaling enterprise analytics infrastructure supporting hundreds of users and petabyte-scale growth.

-Built and administered the enterprise Databricks platform from the ground up, supporting 100+ TB of data and 500+ users across engineering, analytics, and data science.

-Designed platform architecture, access controls, and governance workflows to support secure, large-scale data consumption.

-Championed enterprise-wide dbt adoption, mentoring cross-functional teams and standardizing data modeling practices.

-Reduced analytics delivery timelines and improved transparency by establishing shared modeling standards and best practices.

-Partnered closely with stakeholders to align data platform capabilities with business and compliance requirements.
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Databricks and +5 skills

positions.title: Senior Data Engineer
positions.description:
Senior data engineer focused on high-performance data pipelines, data quality, and analytics enablement for large-scale web applications.

-Architected and built high-performance data pipelines using AWS Glue, Lambda, Snowflake, and SQL, achieving sub-100ms query response times for web applications.

-Developed a data quality platform using AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, Airflow, and Python to execute 1,000+ data quality rules.

-Identified and resolved a $40M executive-visible data issue, restoring trust in enterprise reporting.

-Collaborated with analytics teams to deliver dbt models, reducing delivery cycles from months to one week.

company.name: Cigna Healthcare (via Solomon Page Professional Services)

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
Data engineer working on large-scale industrial and IoT datasets to drive reliability, predictive maintenance, and cost reduction initiatives.

-Led the data initiative that resolved a $10M+ mining truck warranty issue, coordinating across engineering, manufacturing, and analytics teams.

-Engineered ETL pipelines processing terabytes of mining truck telemetry data, enabling failure prediction and proactive maintenance strategies.

-Built analytics datasets and Tableau dashboards to summarize complex telemetry data for technical and business stakeholders.

-Supported data-driven decision making for product quality and reliability programs.

positions.title: Associate Engineer
positions.description:
Early-career engineer in a competitive rotational program supporting manufacturing, quality, and data initiatives.

-Built a Python-based data quality automation tool covering 5,000+ machines, dramatically reducing data defects.

-Work directly influenced the creation of a dedicated data quality engineering role within the organization.

-Gained hands-on experience across engineering, analytics, and operational teams.
